purpose: Paired task-level numerical validation across three public image datasets

architecture.patches: 4 x 4 grid, 7 x 7 grayscale or 8 x 8 RGB patches; all pixels retained

training.schedule: 200-step warmup; cosine to 5% of initial LR
training.augmentation: random translations (2 pixels grayscale; 4 pixels RGB); horizontal flips for Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10; CIFAR reflect padding, grayscale zero padding
training.checkpoint_selection: highest teacher-validation accuracy, lowest CE breaks ties
training.schedule_update: Learning rate is assigned after each optimizer step; the first update uses 0.001.

calibration.sharing: one operator per trained teacher, shared across all four blocks and two heads
calibration.loss: 256 times mean softmax probability squared error
calibration.optimizer: Adam, LR 0.01 cosine to 0.001, gradient clip 5

primary_evaluation.uncertainty: mean and sample SD across three independently trained models, with one prespecified stream realization per full SC evaluation; no claim of repeated full-test streams

diagnostics.note: full-test and diagnostic metrics must not be conflated; sweep error bars use three model results at seed101

stochastic_backend.linear: actual sign-magnitude bits, packed AND/popcount with exact signed integer accumulation
stochastic_backend.softmax: IID-driven saturating 16-state FSMs; latent categorical sampling of row-stochastic tensor-train cores reproduces conditional contraction law
stochastic_backend.GELU: 8-state scalar CDF probability gate times signed magnitude bits
stochastic_backend.LayerNorm: numeric centering, stochastic variance and a 4-state reciprocal-square-root FSM gate
stochastic_backend.arithmetic_streams: digitally shifted distinct coordinates of a scrambled 2-D Sobol net

w8a8_baseline: Numerical dynamic per-token activation/per-output-channel weight symmetric int8 quantization for all learned linear maps and QK products; unsigned 8-bit attention probabilities and per-channel int8 V for AV. Int32 accumulation. Softmax, LN, GELU and residuals remain floating point. No hardware timing inference.
retained_numerical: input normalization, pooling/centering, residual/bias addition, static LN affine gains, sorting/range scaling, stage decode/re-encode and probability comparisons; no gate-level area/energy/latency claims
limits: Compact custom Transformer trained from scratch; not a pretrained state-of-the-art vision backbone. Three datasets do not establish modality, sequence-length or large-model generalization. L excludes FSM burn-in and is not whole-network latency.
